sourceRefs.locator: Manuscript, complete digitisation; Descripción. Colophon naming Seville and 1283, Arabic sources for games, chess, dice and tables, representations of women, men and the monarch playing.
Datos técnicos and Descripción. Castilian text, 97 parchment leaves, tilted boards displaying actual positions, women and men playing and the range of cultural backgrounds shown by the illuminators.

labels.en: Book of Games of Alfonso X
